questions.question: Where am I?
questions.answer: This is the Waterfront — a harbor where each building holds a chapter of Fatima's journey as a software engineer. Wander in, and the town will tell you its story.

questions.question: What is the lighthouse for?
questions.answer: It marks the way. When you're lost, follow the cream-white beam — it always points back to the start.
